# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This batch of recordings is dominated by internal/operational chatter — gift/Diwali-sweet distribution runs, crane/loading coordination, driver dispatch, payment-collection follow-ups, and Porter/location-sharing calls. Only a **moderate subset of genuine sales calls** survives after filtering: inbound rate enquiries for roofing sheets/screws/PUF panels/polycarbonate, a few outbound tele-calling ("Crayon Roofing and Structures-ல இருந்து call பண்ணிருக்கேன்") prospecting calls, one extended dealer-expansion negotiation call, and several "confirm size/diagram" calls with existing B2B customers (fabricators, steel traders). Because the sales-specific content is thin and repetitive (many calls are short rate-quote exchanges), this KB stays close to what is actually said rather than inflating with invented detail.

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on products customers and staff actually discuss:

**1. Metal Roofing Sheets (core product)**
- Brands carried: **JSW Color On Plus**, **JSW Pragathi**, **JSW Radiance**, **JSW Silver On**, **Asian Indradhanush**, **Asian Force**
- Thicknesses quoted: 0.45 mm, 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.6 mm, 0.7 mm (not always in stock)
- Colors mentioned: Sky Blue, Off White, Royal Blue, Dark Green ("Kali Shelt Green"), Half White (9002)
- "அவ்வளவுக்கு 7 mm-ல இல்ல Sir, 0.6 mm-ல sky blue available-ஆ இருக்கு" [0.7mm not in stock, 0.6mm sky blue is available]

**2. PUF (Puff) Insulated Panels** — wall + roof panels, 50 mm thickness discussed for a fabrication/shed job; staff had to check with production on warranty/life since this is a separate factory line from normal roofing sheets.

**3. Polycarbonate Sheets (Lexan brand)** — clear/transparent roofing, Louvre use; thicknesses 1.5 mm, 1.8 mm, 2 mm "standard," with a hard **15 ft standard length** ceiling repeatedly stated.

**4. Screws** — Tata Agri self-drilling screws (full thread, "FT"), sizes: 1 inch, 2 inch, M8x55mm, 2 inch rust-free. Sold by carton (200 pcs small box / 2000 pcs master box pattern varies by call).

**5. Accessories** — L-flash, ridge, gutter, ceiling channel (JSW brand MS channel 125/65), cutter/trims (standard 610 mm 3-side width before rate doubles).

**6. Welding Rods** — Tata brand, and a "Raasi" brand being pushed to dealers with scheme support; competing against Tata in dealer conversations.

**Note:** The company does **not** make liner sheets, UPVC sheets, or GI corrugated MS sheets — multiple calls explicitly redirect such enquiries ("நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லையே" [we don't make that at all]).

Factory location is consistently **Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai** — repeatedly clarified to confused callers (some dial wrong numbers thinking it's "Manipal Steel").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color On Plus 0.47 mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.m** (one quote) and **₹445 + GST / sq.m** (several other quotes, likely later revision)
- JSW Pragathi 0.47 mm Color On Plus: **₹445 + GST / sq.m**; also **₹410 + GST** quoted once ("₹410 * 118% = ₹484" incl. tax)
- Asian Indradhanush 0.45 mm: **₹370 + GST / sq.m** (Force variant); kg-rate version quoted at **₹118/kg + GST**, running-meter weight ~3.7–4.0 kg
- 10 ft sheet, JSW (0.47): **₹1,466 + 18% GST per sheet**
- 10 ft sheet, Asian Indradhanush 0.45: **₹1,251 + 18% GST per sheet** (+ loading charge extra)
- Polycarbonate sheet (2 mm): **₹800 + GST / sq.m**
- Polycarbonate clear (10 mm): **₹61 + tax / sq.ft**
- PUF panel: **~₹1,650 + GST / sq.m**, roughly quoted as "₹2,000 running meter incl. everything"
- Cutter accessory: standard 610 mm width (3 sides combined) = **₹655**; if total width exceeds 610 mm, "full sheet" rate applies and **doubles**
- Tata screws: 1 inch — ₹2.93 + tax; 2 inch — ₹4.44 + tax; 2 inch rust-free — ₹4.66 + tax; M8x55 FT — ~₹4.44 + tax
- MS Channel / welding rod retail dealer pricing discussed in the long dealer call: welding rod packet ₹356 incl. tax vs competitor ₹300–330 (price-war context)

**Payment & delivery terms (explicitly stated):**
- "payment terms வந்து 50% advance payment, balance 50% வந்து delivery-க்கு முன்னாடி payment பண்ணனும்" [50% advance, 50% before delivery]
- "with GST தான் full-ஆவே" — no cash/without-GST billing is done, ever.
- "vehicle உங்க scope தான் வரும்" [transport/vehicle arrangement is customer's responsibility] — repeated on long-distance enquiries (Tirunelveli, Coimbatore, Palakkad customers told to source locally due to high freight).
- Polycarbonate: fixed **15 ft max length**; custom lengths/diagrams require production confirmation and may need 5–9 days lead time.
- Lead times: "coil incoming 4-5 days" + ~2 days delivery = "1 week ஆகும்" for out-of-stock colors.

## Objection Playbook
**1. "இந்த rate ரொம்ப அதிகமா இருக்கு" (Price too high)**
Pattern in calls: sales does not argue; it offers the lower-thickness/
